Let’s start by finding out how much a first‑class ticket from New York (NYC) to Los Angeles (LAX) would cost on October 15, 2026. Once we have that figure, we’ll look at your credit‑card balance and compare it to your $7,000 spending limit. If everything checks out, you can then proceed to book the flight yourself or let me know if you’d like me to contact customer support for assistance.
